lines.text: Many learners say: My birthday is in May 5.
Better: My birthday is on May 5.
The second! The party is on May 3.

native.tip: Com dia e mês juntos, usamos “on”: “on May 5”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “My birthday is in May 5.” O certo é “My birthday is on May 5.” Em português dizemos “no dia 5”, e em inglês o dia exato pede “on”, não “in”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “The party is on May 3.” Agora escreva uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: With a day and month together, we use “on”: “on May 5”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “My birthday is in May 5.” The right way is “My birthday is on May 5.” In Portuguese we say “no dia 5”, and in English an exact day takes “on”, not “in”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
